WoW: Forever

Fury Warrior

Dual-wield damage that spends Rage as fast as two weapons make it. The spec arrives in steps: dual wield at 20, Death WishDeath WishTalentCastInstantCost10 RageCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration30 secWhen activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec. at 30, WhirlwindWhirlwindLevel 36 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 RageCooldown10 sec cooldownIn a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage from both melee weapons to each enemy. at 36, BloodthirstBloodthirstLevel 40 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost30 RageRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration10 secInstantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec. at 40.

WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

Guide to the live game, levels 1 to 60. The talent order is Icy Veins' published Fury levelling build (page dated November 4), checked against the live tree. Level-60 builds are Icy Veins' and Wowhead's, named where they differ. Numbers are the client's unless a source is named.

Two kinds of caveat run through these pages and they do not mean the same thing. Something marked as ours is our own reasoning rather than a source's. Something marked (WoWSims' model) is what a simulator's rotation list does at 60, not a measured result; its combat-log measurements are named as measurements.

No raid is open until December 9, so nothing here is raid-tested. Hover tooltips can show the wrong rank, so where one differs from the prose, believe the prose.

What Fury is for

Sustained damage from two weapons, on one target or a small pack. Two weapons swing more often, Unbridled WrathUnbridled WrathTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantGives you a 60% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon. and Dual Wield SpecializationDual Wield SpecializationTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 25% and the Rage generated by your off-hand attacks by 50%. turn those swings into Rage, and WhirlwindWhirlwindLevel 36 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 RageCooldown10 sec cooldownIn a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage from both melee weapons to each enemy. strikes with both weapons for every dual-wielder, no talent required.

The catch is timing. You cannot dual-wield until level 20, WhirlwindWhirlwindLevel 36 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 RageCooldown10 sec cooldownIn a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage from both melee weapons to each enemy. is level 36 and BloodthirstBloodthirstLevel 40 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost30 RageRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration10 secInstantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec. is 40. Icy Veins says so plainly: until those arrive Fury "can be a bit slower than leveling as Protection", and you may prefer to respec into Fury later with good weapons in hand. Wowhead's Fury page credits the new talents, Gore DrinkerGore DrinkerTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantYour Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, Reckless Swings, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 3 melee attacks to restore 1.0% of your maximum Health. above all, with giving the spec sustain it never had, and lists two-target damage as a strength.

Stat priority

Both weapons matter, the main hand most. On WoWSims' pre-raid Fury set a point of main-hand DPS is worth about 11.5 Attack Power and a point of off-hand DPS about 3.3 (WoWSims' model).

At 60 the sites differ. Icy Veins: weapon DPS, Hit, Expertise, critical strike, Strength. Its Hit figures: 8% caps special attacks against a level 63 boss, and dual-wield white hits would need 27% before talents. Wowhead's list is older, dated October 29 and labelled speculative: weapon skill to 305, Hit to 9%, critical strike, Strength, Agility, Stamina. It does not mention Expertise, which is a new stat that reduces enemy dodges and parries.

Hit feeds Rage. A missed white hit earns nothing, and Icy Veins calls repeated misses Fury's main weakness early on. Crit pays twice: a critical white hit generates 100% increased Rage and starts FlurryFlurryTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases your melee attack speed by 30% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike..

At level 60

Dungeons are the level-60 game until raids open on December 9. Both sites publish a dual-wield BloodthirstBloodthirstLevel 40 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost30 RageRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration10 secInstantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec. build, above. No raid log exists. Wowhead's tier list predates launch tuning and calls itself a prediction, and Blizzard has said it expects a large tuning pass once it has data from players past 30. Wowhead also describes a Fury and Protection hybrid for tanking; the Protection guide covers it.
